summary: Loads and renders a compiled Notch Block (.dfxdll), generating parameters for exposed Notch block properties and selecting output layers for TOP output.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Load/render or release the Notch block instance.

key_params.name: clearparams
key_params.note: Clear exposed parameter values when the block file changes.

key_params.name: block
key_params.note: Path to the compiled .dfxdll Notch Block.

key_params.name: layer
key_params.note: Output layer rendered by the Notch TOP.

key_params.name: playmode
key_params.note: Playback mode: lockedtotimeline, specifyindex, or sequential.

key_params.name: init
key_params.note: Initialize playback at the start without advancing.

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Reset to the start and begin playback.

key_params.name: play
key_params.note: Enable or pause playback in sequential mode.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Playback position when using Specify Index mode.

key_params.name: indexunit
key_params.note: Units for index: samples, frames, or seconds.

key_params.name: purge
key_params.note: Purge video memory used by the block.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark Notch TOP as Windows-only and limited to Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
Commercial and Educational licenses are limited to two active blocks at 1920x1080.
CodeMeter Runtime v7.60+ and the required Notch runtime DLLs must be installed for blocks to load.
Set TOUCH_NOTCH_LOGGING=1 in the Windows environment when diagnosing Notch block load failures.
Exposed CHOP arrays must match the block expected sample and channel layout or the node will warn.
key_concepts: Loads a compiled Notch Block (.dfxdll) and renders a selected output layer as a TOP.
Generates custom TouchDesigner parameters from exposed Notch block properties, preferably using stable Unique Identifiers.
Playback can be locked to the timeline, driven by an explicit index, or run sequentially.
Exposed TOP, CHOP, object, and camera properties have strict data layout and pixel-format expectations.
